boundedMember.acquisition: Bounded HTTP range reads of label-defined offsets. The server answers 206 Partial Content and advertises accept-ranges: bytes. The member is never retrieved or hashed whole, and the pinned label's own axis arithmetic is the only thing that decides an offset.

products.units: dimensionless; the label states no unit and names the samples a strength relative to the frame mean
products.meaning: Archive-published SHARAD three-dimensional delay-time radargram over the eastern part of Deuteronilus Mensae. The pinned PDS4 label owns the grid, sampling, scalar type, projection and statistics; this record owns only the product's identity, origin, closure and limits.
products.citation: Putzig, N., F. Foss, M. Perry, G. Morgan, and P. Sava (2025). Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter SHARAD 3D Radargram Bundle. PDS Geosciences (GEO) Node. https://doi.org/10.17189/a5av-yc11
products.license: NASA scientific data; archive citation requested
products.credit: NASA/JPL Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter SHARAD team, Planetary Science Institute, and the NASA Planetary Data System Geosciences Node
limitations: Delay time is the archive's vertical coordinate, referenced to the areoid plus 10.125 km. The bundle supplies no dielectric model or datum for a metric depth, so no depth conversion is qualified.

The samples are backscatter strength, the square root of backscatter power, relative to the frame mean. They are not ice fraction, density, composition, or a material boundary, and brightness alone does not establish a geologic reflector.

This is an archive-published three-dimensional reconstruction from 466 SHARAD observations over MRO orbits 3081 through 64793, not a direct measurement at each cell, so return localization depends on that reconstruction.

The label's 475 m grid spacing and 0.0375 microsecond delay interval are sampling intervals. Achieved resolution is not supplied here; the bundle's 3d_processing_v2.0.pdf user guide documents the processing parameters.
The archive publishes no checksum for the 26,173,440,000-byte science member. Its advertised length is the only property verified before a read, and every read is a bounded byte range.
The release notes' known imaging artifacts are ground tracks in the Planum Australe version 1 volume, not in this product.

In this label the PDS4 cartography and the array axes are transposed: the upper-left corner x of -337012.5 m equals the array Y start and the upper-left corner y of 303762.5 m is the negated array X start. The reader uses the array axes only, and no geographic position is derived from the cartography here.
